description:
At the Seoul Central District Prosecutors’ Office, Jung Hajun harbors a secret crush. His feelings are for Prosecutor Hyun Juhyuk - the office’s star, the man even defendants can’t help falling for, someone sexy in both face and mind. But there’s one problem: Juhyuk is a homophobe. He’s someone Hajun can neither approach nor allow himself to approach. Then, one night, Hajun happens to meet - or rather, run into - a man claiming to be Juhyuk’s twin. The resemblance is uncanny: identical features, yet his smile never fades, his tone and manner are completely different. Above all, his aura feels nothing alike.

*“I like you. And since I’ve got the same face as Prosecutor Hyun, wouldn’t it be better to sleep with me instead?”*

With a brazen smile, the man tempts him.

*“With this face, I’m offering good sex *and* to play the part of Hyun Juhyuk. Surely you wouldn’t-”*

Of course.

*“...turn me down, would you?”*

There was no reason left to refuse.
